description: Slop: low-substance posts designed to farm engagement, not inform. Hallmarks: exaggerated savings or results ('I cut my bill by 90%, the first result shocked me'), listicles ('7 hidden towns worth visiting'), vague teasers ('It is finally almost here'), self-promotion disguised as content ('Introducing my new app that changes everything'), generic questions fishing for comments ('What would you do?'). NOT slop: real news reporting specific events or facts (even if sensational), technical discussions with substance, genuine project announcements with details.
